newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - June 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - June 30.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Sri Lanka Navy destroys four Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) boats between Pulmoddai and Kokkilai on the east coast on Saturday, killing 40 rebels.

Minister of Justice and Constitutional Affairs G.L. Peiris says the Parliamentary Select Committee process in respect of constituional reform has not been abandoned midway as alleged by a weekend newspaer.
Naval ships blast flotilla of LTTE boats in the east, killing at least 35 rebels, security sources said.
Police in Kalpitiya, north of Colombo, recover 13 barrels of kerosene and diesel which were to be sent to the LTTE in the north.
Police arrest 15 persons and recover 17 firearms which were allegedly stolen from Kuliyapitiya police station in central Sri Lanka.
One LTTE doctor among those killed in the naval attack on flotilla of rebel boats on Saturday, defence sources say.
